study_design: Review/geographic discussion that reports findings from a case-control study of prostate cancer in Japan and the Netherlands.
reason: The reported beta-carotene finding pertains to prostate cancer generally. References to death rates, autopsy prevalence, and lethal cancer do not constitute an exposure analysis of incident aggressive prostate cancer.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: A case-control study of prostate cancer carried out in Japan and the Netherlands revealed a number of statistically significant risk factors, including rural residence, more brothers, colon neoplasms in relatives, no morning erections, frequent sexual intercourse in 30s, episodes of sexually transmitted disease, lower plasma testosterone and dihydrotestosterone concentrations and lower beta-carotene intake.
estimate_classifications.reason: The beta-carotene association is reported for prostate cancer without an aggressive-stage or grade definition.
